findings.description: Policy tests assert literal production Markdown phrases rather than observable inventory or workflow behaviour.
findings.analysis: These assertions can pass for contradictory guidance and fail during harmless wording edits. They do not validate decision-gated lifecycle behaviour.
findings.recommendation: Remove literal prose assertions. Retain actual inventory/index coverage and defer behavioural lifecycle validation to the separate deterministic validator change.
findings.rationale: Literal documentation assertions are not reliable behavioural validation and conflict with the project's testing approach.
